name: The Dispute of the Purple Dye
description: A high-stakes legal trial in a neutral Numidian court. A Roman eques accuses a Carthaginian suffete's kin of seizing a cargo of Tyrian purple dye.

rooms.name: The Great Hall of Justice
rooms.description: A grand hall where the trial takes place. Cold marble and Numidian tapestries.

rooms.name: The Jurors' Chamber
rooms.description: A private room for the jurors to discuss the case. Small, cramped, and tense.

rooms.name: The Public Gallery
rooms.description: Where citizens and interested parties gather to hear news of the trial.

case.defendant: Himilco of the Magonid House (Carthaginian Suffete)
case.charge: Unlawful seizure of cargo in international waters

evidence.name: The Bill of Sale
evidence.description: A slightly charred document in Phoenician script, allegedly proving Drusus's ownership.

evidence.name: The Broken Seal
evidence.description: A wax seal bearing the mark of the Magonid house, found at the site of the 'seizure'.
